name: Charted
line: Our World in Data manners: navy masthead, Playfair headline and a proper chart card (title, subtitle, Chart/Table tabs, gridded axis, source line) in which the smokers' and non-smokers' lung-cancer bars grow from zero, followed by a definitions table and explorers with bar summaries on one shared scale.
notes: All charts are HTML/CSS drawn to scale (0 to 140 per 1,000; 0 to 500 for the explorers' counts; 0 to 20 for the Code). The table tab is keyboard accessible and visible without JavaScript. Lato has no Cyrillic (Playfair Display does).
